_comment: Hand-resolved disagreements in the source material, for generate-foi-bestiary.ts.
Everything here is an assertion, not a preference: the generator FAILS on any conflict it
finds that is not listed below, so a future source edit can't silently bake a guess into a
migration. Each entry needs a reason.
The per-encounter doc (enemies.tsv) is the source of truth for CR and for the running tally;
the DM's aggregate list (enemy-totals.tsv) is only ever a cross-check.
_live_comment: Rows that already exist in the LIVE database because someone made them in the app. The generator
can only see the seed migrations, so without these two maps it invents a duplicate — which is
exactly what 0034 did before 0035 cleaned up after it. Add to these whenever the DM has already
written up a session or a plate by hand.
sessionIds: session number (or 'N.5' for a side session) -> the existing session's id. A number
listed here gets NO placeholder row, and every creature fought in it links to the real session.
monsterIds: creature name -> the existing plate's id, so the ledger's numbers land on the plate
that already carries the DM's artwork instead of beside it.
_cr_comment: Rows in enemies.tsv that disagree with themselves about a creature's CR. Only a name listed here may have more than one CR in the doc, and the value below is the one that ships.
_docOnly_comment: Creatures in the per-encounter doc that the aggregate list has not caught up with. They still get imported — the doc is the record of what was actually fought.
_totalsOnly_comment: Creatures in the aggregate list with no encounter in the doc. They are NOT imported: without a session there is nothing to link them to.
_amount_comment: Names where the doc's summed amount and the aggregate list's Amount column disagree. The doc's sum ships as `encountered`.
_crMismatch_comment: Names where the doc's CR and the aggregate list's CR disagree. The doc's CR ships.
